title: On Modifying the plan after the first trial
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：modify　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 modify 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the writer ① modified the plan after the first trial year after year, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② modifies the plan after the first trial for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ modify the plan after the first trial at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ modified the plan after the first trial before — a line in the manuscript for January 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Modifying the plan after the first trial year after year, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ modify the tone of the letter for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Modify the tone of the letter at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ modifies the tone of the letter year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ modified the plan after the first trial again when nobody else would.

⑩ To modify the plan after the first trial, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody modifies the plan after the first trial for the whole place again and somebody must modify the plan after the first trial year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 修改（一般过去式 modified the plan after the first trial：1982 年写作者头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 修改（一般现在 modifies the plan after the first trial：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 修改（不定式 to modify the plan after the first trial：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 修改（过去完成时 had modified the plan after the first trial：1976 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 修改（动名词 modifying the plan after the first trial 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 缓和（modify the tone of the letter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去缓和把信的语气缓和下来）
G. v. 缓和（modify the tone of the letter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 修改（后段两处：新来的读者照例 modifies the tone of the letter，而母亲又一次 modified the plan after the first trial）

answers.why: modify 意为“修改”，1982 年写作者年年地修改试过一次之后修改那方案，那是书斋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 modified。
modify 意为“修改”，自那以后写作者替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 modifies。
modify 意为“修改”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯修改试过一次之后修改那方案”，此处为不定式 to modify the plan after the first trial。
modify 意为“修改”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人修改过，故用过去完成时 had modified。
modify 意为“修改”，写作者说“修改试过一次之后修改那方案这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 modifying the plan after the first trial 作主语。
modify 意为“缓和”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去缓和把信的语气缓和下来”，should ever 之后用原形 modify the tone of the letter。
modify 意为“缓和”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻缓和把信的语气缓和下来（modify the tone of the letter at once），以后再也不要提起。
modify 意为“修改”，新来的读者每个月份都照例缓和把信的语气缓和下来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 modifies。
modify 意为“修改”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地修改试过一次之后修改那方案，用一般过去式 modified 叙述。
modify 意为“修改”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要修改试过一次之后修改那方案，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，写作者年年地修改试过一次之后修改那方案；书斋里每一个读者都说这是头一回。（modified the plan after the first trial）
多年以后，写作者仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（modifies the plan after the first trial）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯修改试过一次之后修改那方案这件事本身。（to modify the plan after the first trial）
早在 1976 年就有人修改试过一次之后修改那方案，一月那天手稿上的一行字就是证据。（had modified the plan after the first trial）
写作者说过，年年地修改试过一次之后修改那方案这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（modifying the plan after the first trial 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻缓和把信的语气缓和下来，以后再也不要提起。（modify the tone of the letter，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 modify 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the writer modified the plan after the first trial year after year, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer modifies the plan after the first trial for the whole place whenever the study asks.
Modifying the plan after the first trial year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever modify the tone of the letter for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study modifies the tone of the letter year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother modified the plan after the first trial again, and the study remembered that half.
